Contamination from communal sewage farms, fish ponds, but especially diffuse contamination from agriculture pollutes the mass balance of the Werse and leads to eutrophication along the entire river course, especially in the retention basin areas. The Werse rises in the Beckum Hills near Beckum from three headstreams: the *Lippbach*, *Kollenbach* and *Siechenbach "Siechenbach (Kollenbach)")*. The name *Werse* is used from the Osttor and above the Kollenbach. Near Münster-Gelmer") near the Haskenau") it finally discharges into the Ems "Ems (river)").
